row: Welcome to the Springhill Equine Veterinary Clinic's Youtube channel! Whether you found us through our podcast (Straight from the Horse Doctor's Mouth), our books (The Adventures of the Horse Doctor's Husband series), our veterinary clinic, or some other way, we're glad you're here! The purpose of our videos is to help horse owners provide better care to their animals through education. Springhill Equine Veterinary Clinic is located in Newberry, Florida, and serves the North Central Florida region with premier healthcare for horses and other large animals. Please visit our website at www.SpringhillEquine.com to learn more about us.
